name: com.rezabehjat.capture
description: Stream Deck+ plugin: an interface to Capture (lighting visualizer)

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test test/osc.test.ts test/properties.test.ts test/applescript.test.ts test/menu.test.ts test/timing.test.ts test/stub.test.ts test/ax.test.ts test/axkeys.test.ts test/render.test.ts test/integration.test.ts
scripts.pack: npm run gen-ui && npm run build && streamdeck validate com.rezabehjat.capture.sdPlugin && streamdeck pack com.rezabehjat.capture.sdPlugin --output dist --force
